description: This Java class 'ServerHitBin' is responsible for tracking and aggregating server hits and statistics for requests, events, views, entities, and services within the OFBiz web application framework. It manages real-time binning of hit data, persistence of hit records, and maintains cumulative counters since server start. The class references several external utility classes for properties, database access, and servlet request handling.

classes.name: ServerHitBin
classes.description: A final class for tracking server hits, aggregating statistics into time bins, and persisting data. It maintains counters for hits, times, and supports dynamic binning based on configured bin length. Provides methods for counting various request types, persisting hit data, and accumulating global statistics.

methods.name: countRequest
methods.description: Counts a server request hit for a given identifier, request object, start time, runtime, and user info.

methods.name: countEvent
methods.description: Counts an event occurrence with associated request and timing data.
